campaign-plan-1.prompt: Plan a 6-week launch campaign for Tallyho, a EUR 12/month invoicing app for Dutch freelancers (zzp'ers). Goal: 1,500 paid signups by 2027-03-31. Budget EUR 15,000. Launch date 2027-01-12. Audience: freelancers who invoice from Word or Excel today. We have a 4,000-person waitlist and no paid-ads history.

campaign-plan-2.prompt: We're Ferrous, a 20-person B2B data-pipeline startup. Plan an 8-week lead-gen push for our new Postgres change-data-capture connector. Budget EUR 40,000, target 300 sales-qualified leads. Buyers are data-platform leads at 200-2,000 person companies. Our current pipeline comes mostly from our open-source repo (9k GitHub stars) and two conference talks a year.

competitive-brief-1.prompt: Competitive brief: Tallyho (EUR 12/month invoicing app for Dutch freelancers, iDEAL payment links on every invoice, quarterly btw overview) versus Moneybird and e-Boekhouden. We are cheaper but we have no bank-feed integration yet. Where should we position, and what should sales say?

competitive-brief-2.prompt: Assume this as given: Linear has just launched a free tier for teams of up to 10 people. We sell Trackwise, an issue tracker at USD 8 per seat aimed at small dev agencies (5-30 people), with built-in client portals and time tracking. Brief me on what this means for us and how we should respond in the next 30 days.

email-sequence-1.prompt: Write the onboarding email sequence for Tallyho trial users. Tallyho is a EUR 12/month invoicing app for Dutch freelancers. The trial is 14 days, card not required. Activation means sending the first invoice. Today 38% of trials send an invoice and 11% convert to paid.

email-sequence-2.prompt: Build a win-back email sequence for CleanPlate, a meal-kit subscription, aimed at customers who cancelled in the last 90 days. Top cancel reasons from the exit survey: price (45%), too many leftovers (30%), skipping weeks is too hard (15%), other (10%). We can offer up to 30% off for two boxes, and we recently launched 2-person half-portions and one-click skip.

draft-content-1.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post and a 600-word blog post announcing that Ferrous' Postgres change-data-capture connector is generally available. Key facts: sub-second end-to-end latency in our benchmark (p95 420 ms at 20k rows/s), no replication-slot bloat thanks to slot heartbeats, open source under Apache-2.0, managed version on Ferrous Cloud.

draft-content-2.prompt: Draft a press release: CleanPlate, an Amsterdam meal-kit subscription with 120,000 active customers, has raised an EUR 8M Series A led by Harbour Ventures, with participation from existing investor Polder Capital. The money funds expansion to Belgium in spring 2027 and a new packaging line that cuts plastic by 60%. Spokesperson: co-founder and CEO Ines de Wit.

brand-review-1.prompt: Review this launch email against our brand guide before it ships. Brand guide: INPUTS/tallyho-brand-guide.md. Email: INPUTS/draft-email.md.
